Name: Drakos
Author: Drakos Team
Description:
A plugin to automate crafting, gathering, and market board functions. Drakos allows you to construct orders and automate gathering, crafting, and undercutting on the market board.

/drakos opens the Drakos window.
/drakos kill stops everything Drakos is doing at once. Reload the plugin to use Drakos again.
/drakos license on signs this character in to Drakos licensing.
/drakos license off gently stops running automation, then signs this character out of Drakos licensing.
/drakos unlockall unlocks every crafting and gathering class, with its starter quests and a gearset.
/drakos unlockall resume continues unlock all after it waited for you.
/drakos market opens the Market tab.
/drakos market start [--worldhop] [--file "C:/path/list.json"] buys your saved buy list, or the exported list in the file, hopping worlds when asked.
/drakos orders opens the Orders tab.
/drakos orders start [--file "C:/path/order.json"] starts or continues the order drafted in the Orders tab, after loading the file into it when one is named.
/drakos orders resume continues the order waiting for you, or your newest saved order.
/drakos craft <name> [x<count>], <name> ... crafts the first match of each name.
/drakos gather <name> [x<count>], <name> ... gathers or fishes the first match of each name.
